history.text: Agadez became a Tuareg sultanate and a trans-Saharan trade hub.
France made Niger a colony within French West Africa.
Tuareg rebellions in the north ended in peace agreements.
A new constitution restored civilian rule after a coup.

worthSeeing.title: Air and Tenere:
worthSeeing.text: A desert reserve of massifs and dunes, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Agadez:
worthSeeing.text: The mud-brick minaret of the 16th-century mosque, a UNESCO site.

worthSeeing.title: W National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Savannah on the Niger River shared with Benin and Burkina Faso.
